partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: LOF cellular-component restoration
results.hypothesis: Increasing a cellular component containing an explicit LOF disease driver may restore deficient complex or organelle function.
results.body: drug increases cellular component; LOF driver is part of component and causes disease
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule aligns a signed direct component effect with explicit LOF genetics and physical component membership, although the graph does not identify which component function changes.
results.trapi_notes: The three-edge motif and variant qualifier are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusions and disease ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(component:CellularComponent)
      <-[:PART_OF]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.mechanism_rationale: The drug direction reinforces rather than repairs the genetically deficient component.
